purpose: Frozen Week 6 context-sensitivity gate. It reuses the exact nine dataset content pins and split contract from the completed Week 5 full experiment. For each fixed held-out query and fixed support anchors, it replaces only the non-anchor background context. Alpha and aligned pre-softmax scores are retained separately so softmax competition is never misreported as a raw-score context shift.

preprocessing.feature_policy: numeric-only float64; reject non-finite values; no imputation, feature selection, or target-derived transform
preprocessing.label_policy: encode observed target labels deterministically after loading; support labels may enter Teacher contexts; query labels never enter a Teacher fit
preprocessing.sample_id_policy: source row index is retained as dataset_id:row:<index>

split.selection: deterministic stratified holdout without replacement; query rows are first sampled from the 20 percent holdout, and support rows are sampled only from the remaining train pool

context.query_selection: label-blind seeded sample without replacement from the frozen holdout query order
context.anchor_selection: deterministic support-label round-robin over the frozen support order; fixed anchors are present in every context
context.background_selection: for each context, sample without replacement from non-anchor support rows with the same frozen proportional per-class quota; only background IDs change across contexts
context.support_order: each context is sorted by original frozen support position before the Teacher fit
context.raw_score_aggregation: retain every exact [estimator, head] raw-score surface; compute ranking metrics per surface and macro-average them. ReadoutExtraction.mean_raw_scores is retained only as a secondary diagnostic
context.alpha_analysis: record full alpha and anchor mass; normalize alpha only within the fixed anchor universe for cross-context anchor ranking diagnostics
context.leakage_boundary: every Teacher fit receives support features, support labels, support IDs, query features, and query IDs only; query labels are never passed to the bridge or released to a Teacher fit

controls.order_control: for the first label-blind selected query in every dataset/seed, rerun context zero with its support rows reversed and compare only ID-aligned anchors. Version 2 replaces the v1 elementwise raw absolute tolerance with relation-level invariants plus gross-error numeric guardrails; the v1 elementwise threshold sat below the measured cross-order float-accumulation noise floor of this environment
controls.raw_atol_scope: same-context repeat control only in v2; the reversed-support-order control no longer uses an elementwise raw tolerance

order_relation_checks.nan_policy: a surface with no comparable non-tied pairs reports NaN and passes vacuously; NaN surfaces are recorded in the control record for audit

order_numeric_guardrails.note: scale-free gross-error tripwire only. Calibration evidence: cross-order raw noise is scale-relative 1.7-2.4e-6 at smoke scale (32 rows, order-audit week06-order-audit-aa60b3b62082-2e6591d4) and 7.2-8.4e-6 at full 512-support scale (probe week06-v2-probe-6dbe4437b649-65a2f115), while absolute noise grows ~11x from 32 to 512 rows (2.4e-5 -> 2.7e-4), so the v2 absolute guardrail (1e-4) was miscalibrated and is replaced by the scale-relative bound; relation-level invariants held exactly at both scales

controls.purpose: reject run-to-run stochasticity or support-row order as an explanation for composition-induced shifts, using relation-level invariants on the invariant anchor universe
controls.alpha_atol_scope: same-context repeat control only since v4; the order control evaluates alpha through relation-level invariants

order_alpha_checks.note_on_dead_zone: normalized shares are probabilities in [0,1]; the 1e-4 dead zone exceeds the measured cross-order share noise (<=7e-6 at 512 support rows) by >14x, so stochasticity cannot flip a comparable pair by construction
order_alpha_checks.calibration: order-audit (smoke, 32 rows): alpha elementwise <=1.1e-7; full sweep (27 combos, 512 rows): alpha elementwise <=2.0e-6, anchor-total relative drift <=4.5e-5, normalized-share ranking identical everywhere measured

metrics.pairwise_comparison: all unordered pairs in the fixed anchor universe
metrics.scientific_primary_metrics: raw-score anchor ranking and pairwise raw-score differences; alpha-only movement is reported as softmax competition evidence, not as a context-shift claim

gate.aggregation: for each query, summarize all contexts; per-seed value is the median of fixed-query summaries; per-dataset value is the median across seeds; global route uses a strict majority of the nine dataset regimes

strong.rule: at least two raw ranking-instability conditions; alpha-only instability never triggers strong context

gate.weak_route: STATIC_REPRESENTATION_CANDIDATE; Week 5 was mixed, so Week 7 must still resolve static symmetric versus directed
gate.moderate_route: CONTEXT_ADAPTER_CANDIDATE; use a simple context adapter before a full context-conditioned model
gate.strong_route: CONTEXT_CONDITIONED_DIRECTED_CANDIDATE; first context encoder must be DeepSets
